questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Relevance to my studies and interests, i.e. studying in Britain is relevant to my BA in English, and the University of Birmingham offers courses in corpus, cognitive and psycholinguistics which I wanted to learn more about

questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Studio apartments and shared housing

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: There was a bookable fully-equipped kitchen by the student lounge

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: The accommodation team offers a wide variety of free activities for residents, e.g. yoga classes and other sports, wellfair cafés, etc.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The process of choosing an accommodation was extremely stressful, as there was an alotted time frame to make your decision but it was simultaneous with other students, so the options quickly dwindled. As I arrived in the winter/spring there were fewer options and the one's I had been looking at prior to the selection time were not available. Thus, it was hard to make an informed decision when there was time pressure and an uncertain range of options. For instance, there were no accommodations available with en suite bathrooms except for studio apartments. The weekly prices were not particularly student-friendly though

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I was asked to fill out a Google Analysis sheet with up to 12 priorities of courses. If there are any issues with the schedule, however, you have to email the course administration team and choose a new course. They do not check whether the classes overlap, and you are not given the courses corresponding to the priority list given initially

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Some colleges had meeting points and hours for tutors and administrative assistance. I was unable to find any information for my college, however. I had to contact them via email

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was given my top three priorities, but due to schedule overlap I had to choose a new course. This process took a week, as most courses were already full, the response time was slow and the information was not updated, causing me to miss a week of lectures in the course I was reassigned to

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Make sure you are familiar with the rules regarding attendance, and check that your classes do not overlap

questions.answer: Quite easy, it is not too dissimilar to Danish culture

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None - except remember to signal to bus drivers that you want to get on their bus, otherwise they will drive past

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The diversity

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Establish contacts early on. There are not many weeks of classes, so it can be hard to meet new people after classes end
Take advantage of the commodities, free events and activities offered
Enjoy the nature and surroundings

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Semi-skimmed milk is the closest version to letmælk, skimmed is very diluted and whole milk is very thick
If you are living in student accommodations from the university, buy a laundry hamper or bring a big grocery bag, as you will likely have to walk a bit to get to the laundry facilities

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Immersion in the everyday culture and nature

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Making friends with local students - most had already established friend groups as they had studied together for a longer time
